s0401.literal: On gengchen day, privy council officials said: "In the sixth month, mobile privy council officials fought the Wusa rebel troops five times with troops and defeated them; only Luchu remains in hiding and has not been captured.
s0401.idiomatic: On gengchen day, privy council officials said: "In the 6th month, mobile privy council officials fought the Wusa rebel troops 5 times with troops and defeated them; only Luchu remains in hiding and has not been captured.

s0402.literal: The Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply their military provisions.
s0402.idiomatic: The Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply their military provisions.

s0403.literal: Two thousand shi of grain were distributed to relieve the famine people of Xinghe Baochang Prefecture.
s0403.idiomatic: 2,000 shi of grain were distributed to relieve the famine people of Xinghe Baochang Prefecture.

s0404.literal: Censorate officials said: "Grand Sacrificial Director Yan Jixiang of the Great Sage Longevity Ten Thousand Peace Monastery, stealing government goods and keeping wife and children — he should be removed from his posts as Grand Mentor and Grand Sacrificial Director.
s0404.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Grand Sacrificial Director Yan Jixiang of the Great Sage Longevity Ten Thousand Peace Monastery, stealing government goods and keeping wife and children — he should be removed from his posts as Grand Mentor and Grand Sacrificial Director.

s0406.literal: All relay stations were forbidden to keep stolen traveling horses; miscellaneous corvée of Crane-Control households was remitted.
s0406.idiomatic: All relay stations were forbidden to keep stolen traveling horses; miscellaneous corvée of Crane-Control households was remitted.

s0407.literal: In Anji County of Huzhou, long rains overflowed Tai Lake, floating away two thousand eight hundred ninety households' dwellings, drowning one hundred fifty-seven men and women; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve and comfort them.
s0407.idiomatic: In Anji County of Huzhou, long rains overflowed Tai Lake, floating away 2,890 households' dwellings, drowning 157 men and women; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve and comfort them.

s0408.literal: On dinghai day, censorate officials said: "Jiangxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Li Yunzhong is the adopted son of the former inner attendant Li Bangning; his substance is mediocre and low — mistakenly receiving heavy selection; he should be dismissed.
s0408.idiomatic: On dinghai day, censorate officials said: "Jiangxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Li Yunzhong is the adopted son of the former inner attendant Li Bangning; his substance is mediocre and low — mistakenly receiving heavy selection; he should be dismissed.

s0410.literal: On gengyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting the Sagely Temple.
s0410.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting the Sagely Temple.

s0411.literal: Fifty thousand ingots of notes and advance loans of fifty thousand ingots of next year's Sichuan salt duty notes were granted for mobile privy council military supplies.
s0411.idiomatic: 50,000 ingots of notes and advance loans of 50,000 ingots of next year's Sichuan salt duty notes were granted for mobile privy council military supplies.

s0413.literal: On guisi day, the Supply Provisioning Directorate Verification Office was abolished and the Broad Beneficence Office was established, rank positive third grade; right chancellor Sadi was placed in charge of its affairs.
s0413.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Supply Provisioning Directorate Verification Office was abolished and the Broad Beneficence Office was established, rank positive 3rd grade; right chancellor Sadi was placed in charge of its affairs.

s0414.literal: Censorate officials impeached Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Director Tongtong for licentious extravagance and impurity, unfit to attend bright sacrifices;
s0414.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Director Tongtong for licentious extravagance and impurity, unfit to attend bright sacrifices;

s0415.literal: moreover, Kuizhang Pavilion supervising academician Ke Jiusi — his nature is not purely good, his conduct extremely affected and deceitful, wielding petty skills to attach himself to powerful gates — they requested dismissal.
s0415.idiomatic: moreover, Kuizhang Pavilion supervising academician Ke Jiusi — his nature is not purely good, his conduct extremely affected and deceitful, wielding petty skills to attach himself to powerful gates — they requested dismissal.

s0416.literal: On yiwei day, a gold tiger tally was granted to central secretariat associate grand councillor Yiliechi.
s0416.idiomatic: On yiwei day, a gold tiger tally was granted to central secretariat associate grand councillor Yiliechi.

s0417.literal: Zhenyuan Prefecture of Sizhou Route suffered famine; five hundred shi of grain were distributed in relief.
s0417.idiomatic: Zhenyuan Prefecture of Sizhou Route suffered famine; 500 shi of grain were distributed in relief.

s0418.literal: On dingyou day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat dispatched commissioner Na Hai, pacification commissioner Luan Zhi, and others bearing an edict to instruct Luchu and invest him with associate administrator patent; reaching Sajia Pass, Luchu refused to receive it; presently rebels arrived in great force; Na Hai therefore fought with strength and the rebels then withdrew.
s0418.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat dispatched commissioner Na Hai, pacification commissioner Luan Zhi, and others bearing an edict to instruct Luchu and invest him with associate administrator patent; reaching Sajia Pass, Luchu refused to receive it; presently rebels arrived in great force; Na Hai therefore fought with strength and the rebels then withdrew.

s0419.literal: By evening, Wusa troops entered Shunyuan territory; left chancellor Temür Buqa resisted in battle; Na Hai again went to the front to proclaim the edict and recruit them, and was thereupon killed; Temür Buqa and others gathered troops and returned.
s0419.idiomatic: By evening, Wusa troops entered Shunyuan territory; left chancellor Temür Buqa resisted in battle; Na Hai again went to the front to proclaim the edict and recruit them, and was thereupon killed; Temür Buqa and others gathered troops and returned.

s0420.literal: On renyin day, the Longxiang Chief Steward's Office was changed to the Longxiang Commissionerate, rank secondary second grade.
s0420.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Longxiang Chief Steward's Office was changed to the Longxiang Commissionerate, rank secondary 2nd grade.

s0421.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiachen day, secretary supervisor Wang Gui and others were dispatched to perform sacrifices at the mountain peaks, sea deities, and Hou Tu.
s0421.idiomatic: Winter, 10th month, on jiachen day, secretary supervisor Wang Gui and others were dispatched to perform sacrifices at the mountain peaks, sea deities, and Hou Tu.

s0422.literal: On yisi day, mobile privy council Cherig Temür and Xiao Yunshi were recalled to court.
s0422.idiomatic: On yisi day, mobile privy council Cherig Temür and Xiao Yunshi were recalled to court.

s0423.literal: Former Dongchuan Route chief steward Puzhe's son Anle inherited his father's post.
s0423.idiomatic: Former Dongchuan Route chief steward Puzhe's son Anle inherited his father's post.

s0424.literal: On jiyou day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.
s0424.idiomatic: On jiyou day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.

s0425.literal: Buddhist rites were performed for Prince Guna Nadala; prisoners in the capital were released — two condemned to death and forty-seven condemned to strokes.
s0425.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed for Prince Guna Nadala; prisoners in the capital were released — 2 condemned to death and 47 condemned to strokes.

s0426.literal: On xinhai day, Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Arslan Qaya was summoned to court.
s0426.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Arslan Qaya was summoned to court.

s0427.literal: On guichou day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting the Sagely Temple.
s0427.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting the Sagely Temple.

s0428.literal: Mongol supreme commander Qilie led troops against Ahe bandit partisans at Haizhong Mountain on Chengjiang Route, used scaling ladders to mount the mountain, broke their palisade, and killed more than five hundred bandits.
s0428.idiomatic: Mongol supreme commander Qilie led troops against Ahe bandit partisans at Haizhong Mountain on Chengjiang Route, used scaling ladders to mount the mountain, broke their palisade, and killed more than 500 bandits.

s0429.literal: Tuojian's younger brother Birdaghusamsi led his whole household to drown in the sea.
s0429.idiomatic: Tuojian's younger brother Birdaghusamsi led his whole household to drown in the sea.

s0430.literal: Two more younger brothers and three sons of Tuojian were captured and executed.
s0430.idiomatic: 2 more younger brothers and 3 sons of Tuojian were captured and executed.

s0431.literal: On jiayin day, Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve those unable to support themselves.
s0431.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve those unable to support themselves.

s0432.literal: On dingsi day, central secretariat officials said: "In Pingjiang, Huzhou, and other routes of Jiang-Zhe, floods damaged the crops; next year sea transport grain is two million six hundred thousand shi — we fear it will not suffice; if one million nine hundred thousand are transported, with Henan issuing three hundred thousand and Jiangxi one hundred thousand, that would be appropriate.
s0432.idiomatic: On dingsi day, central secretariat officials said: "In Pingjiang, Huzhou, and other routes of Jiang-Zhe, floods damaged the crops; next year sea transport grain is 2,600,000 shi — we fear it will not suffice; if 1,900,000 are transported, with Henan issuing 300,000 and Jiangxi 100,000, that would be appropriate.

s0433.literal: Also, officials bearing one hundred thousand ingots and thirty-five thousand salt certificates were dispatched to Tong, Lu, Ling, and Cang Prefectures to purchase thirty thousand shi of rice at preferential prices.
s0433.idiomatic: Also, officials bearing 100,000 ingots and 35,000 salt certificates were dispatched to Tong, Lu, Ling, and Cang Prefectures to purchase 30,000 shi of rice at preferential prices.

s0434.literal: Also, twenty-five thousand ingots and fifteen thousand salt certificates at Tong and Lu Prefectures to purchase one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain and beans;
s0434.idiomatic: Also, 25,000 ingots and 15,000 salt certificates at Tong and Lu Prefectures to purchase 150,000 shi of grain and beans;

s0435.literal: also, three hundred thousand ingots to Liaoyang Yi and Jin Prefectures to purchase one hundred thousand shi of grain and beans."
s0435.idiomatic: also, 300,000 ingots to Liaoyang Yi and Jin Prefectures to purchase 100,000 shi of grain and beans."

s0437.literal: More than two million seven hundred thousand ingots of long-stored worn and faded notes in the capital were burned.
s0437.idiomatic: More than 2,700,000 ingots of long-stored worn and faded notes in the capital were burned.

s0438.literal: On wuwu day, an edict returned one hundred qing of fields of the Great Jade Pure Manifestation Palace of Pingjiang Route — officials were not to collect rent.
s0438.idiomatic: On wuwu day, an edict returned 100 qing of fields of the Great Jade Pure Manifestation Palace of Pingjiang Route — officials were not to collect rent.

s0439.literal: On jiwei day, fodder and beans were issued to imperial guard soldiers who held office.
s0439.idiomatic: On jiwei day, fodder and beans were issued to imperial guard soldiers who held office.

s0440.literal: Prince Bosaiyin's envoys returned to the Western Regions; an edict compensated the value of medicines they had offered.
s0440.idiomatic: Prince Bosaiyin's envoys returned to the Western Regions; an edict compensated the value of medicines they had offered.

s0441.literal: On xinyou day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Xingsheng Palace for fifteen days before stopping.
s0441.idiomatic: On xinyou day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Xingsheng Palace for 15 days before stopping.

s0442.literal: In Wujiang Prefecture great wind and rain overflowed Tai Lake, floating away one thousand nine hundred seventy households' dwellings and livestock; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to grant one thousand five hundred ingots for relief.
s0442.idiomatic: In Wujiang Prefecture great wind and rain overflowed Tai Lake, floating away 1,970 households' dwellings and livestock; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to grant 1,500 ingots for relief.

s0443.literal: On yichou day, the Illustrious Merit Ten-Thousand-Household Chief Commandant's Office was established; Bayan and Temür Buqa were both made to concurrently hold the post of Illustrious Merit ten-thousand-household chief commandant.
s0443.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Illustrious Merit Ten-Thousand-Household Chief Commandant's Office was established; Bayan and Temür Buqa were both made to concurrently hold the post of Illustrious Merit ten-thousand-household chief commandant.

s0444.literal: On bingyin day, Dadu Route was ordered to fix periodic price assessments and on the first and fifteenth of each month send them to the Broad Beneficence Office to balance commodity prices.
s0444.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Dadu Route was ordered to fix periodic price assessments and on the 1st and 15th of each month send them to the Broad Beneficence Office to balance commodity prices.

s0445.literal: Yan Temür obtained five thousand yaks from the Western Regions and presented them.
s0445.idiomatic: Yan Temür obtained 5,000 yaks from the Western Regions and presented them.

s0446.literal: Eleventh month, on renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0446.idiomatic: 11th month, on renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0447.literal: Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "For state horses pastured in Yiqibuxie lands, salt was given annually; fed on it on each month's upper yin day, the horses were strong and without disease.
s0447.idiomatic: Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "For state horses pastured in Yiqibuxie lands, salt was given annually; fed on it on each month's upper yin day, the horses were strong and without disease.

s0448.literal: Recently because of Boqu's rebellion, southern salt could not reach them and many horses died of disease."
s0448.idiomatic: Recently because of Boqu's rebellion, southern salt could not reach them and many horses died of disease."

s0449.literal: An edict ordered Sichuan Branch Secretariat to supply them with salt.
s0449.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sichuan Branch Secretariat to supply them with salt.

s0450.literal: On yihai day, Li Yantong, Xiao Bulanxi, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
s0450.idiomatic: On yihai day, Li Yantong, Xiao Bulanxi, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

s0451.literal: On bingzi day, Prince Woqi was enfeoffed Prince of Baoning and granted a seal; the seal he had formerly received was granted to Prince Huntoutemür's son Gengutai.
s0451.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Prince Woqi was enfeoffed Prince of Baoning and granted a seal; the seal he had formerly received was granted to Prince Huntoutemür's son Gengutai.

s0452.literal: An edict granted Yelü Sinu the branch secretariat seal.
s0452.idiomatic: An edict granted Yelü Sinu the branch secretariat seal.

s0453.literal: On dingchou day, in Xinghe Route hawk establishment and among eleven thousand one hundred plus Mongol households, great snow froze livestock to death; five thousand shi of grain were distributed in relief.
s0453.idiomatic: On dingchou day, in Xinghe Route hawk establishment and among 11,100 plus Mongol households, great snow froze livestock to death; 5,000 shi of grain were distributed in relief.

s0454.literal: On wuyin day, privy council officials said: "When troops rose in the Tiansli era, because Yangzhou is a strategic strongpoint, Huaidong Pacification Commission troops were temporarily lent military authority; now affairs are settled and their troops should again be subordinated to Henan Branch Secretariat.
s0454.idiomatic: On wuyin day, privy council officials said: "When troops rose in the Tiansli era, because Yangzhou is a strategic strongpoint, Huaidong Pacification Commission troops were temporarily lent military authority; now affairs are settled and their troops should again be subordinated to Henan Branch Secretariat.

s0455.literal: Also, the Western Campaign Martial Prince's headquarters from Taiding's beginning deployed four thousand one hundred men to garrison Longla and Yijinay — rotation was set at five years; now ten years have passed and deserters are many; preferential treatment should be increased, with rotation to return next year's fifth month."
s0455.idiomatic: Also, the Western Campaign Martial Prince's headquarters from Taiding's beginning deployed 4,100 men to garrison Longla and Yijinay — rotation was set at 5 years; now 10 years have passed and deserters are many; preferential treatment should be increased, with rotation to return next year's 5th month."

s0457.literal: On jimao day, Zhanban was enfeoffed Duke of Bin State.
s0457.idiomatic: On jimao day, Zhanban was enfeoffed Duke of Bin State.

s0458.literal: On gengchen day, one thousand four hundred ninety households of Left and Right Qinch'a Guard soldiers suffered famine; Shangdu garrison command was ordered to relieve them.
s0458.idiomatic: On gengchen day, 1,490 households of Left and Right Qinch'a Guard soldiers suffered famine; Shangdu garrison command was ordered to relieve them.

s0459.literal: On xinsi day, Minister of Revenue Geng Huan was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0459.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Minister of Revenue Geng Huan was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0460.literal: On guimao day, an edict adopted Yan Temür's son Talahai as son and granted a residence and the property of Li Yantong that had been registered.
s0460.idiomatic: On guimao day, an edict adopted Yan Temür's son Talahai as son and granted a residence and the property of Li Yantong that had been registered.

s0461.literal: Prince of Jing Yesudubugan presented four hundred yaks.
s0461.idiomatic: Prince of Jing Yesudubugan presented 400 yaks.

s0462.literal: Edict: "Each year the privy council and Court of the Imperial Clan shall dispatch officials with Liaoyang Branch Secretariat officials to tour the prefectures — do not let the princes' subordinates disturb the people."
s0462.idiomatic: Edict: "Each year the privy council and Court of the Imperial Clan shall dispatch officials with Liaoyang Branch Secretariat officials to tour the prefectures — do not let the princes' subordinates disturb the people."

s0463.literal: Longxiang commissioner Huanggur Buqa said: "The Great Prospering Dragon Universal Bright Monastery built in Hainan — its labor costs vast and heavy; the Li people could not bear the oppression and thus rose in revolt."
s0463.idiomatic: Longxiang commissioner Huanggur Buqa said: "The Great Prospering Dragon Universal Bright Monastery built in Hainan — its labor costs vast and heavy; the Li people could not bear the oppression and thus rose in revolt."

s0464.literal: An edict ordered Huguang Branch Secretariat official Yolu Buhua and the two Pacification commissions to take charge of the labor, with surveillance commissioners still overseeing.
s0464.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huguang Branch Secretariat official Yolu Buhua and the 2 Pacification commissions to take charge of the labor, with surveillance commissioners still overseeing.

s0465.literal: On xinmao day, Prince Sarman's envoys, seventy-four persons, arrived.
s0465.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Prince Sarman's envoys, 74 persons, arrived.

s0466.literal: Relief was distributed to one thousand five hundred eighty households of the Left Qinch'a Guard Sadun wing wintering at Dinger Gumug.
s0466.idiomatic: Relief was distributed to 1,580 households of the Left Qinch'a Guard Sadun wing wintering at Dinger Gumug.

s0467.literal: Salt duty notes were collected at one-tenth in silver; each ingot of silver fifty taels was converted to twenty-five ingots of notes.
s0467.idiomatic: Salt duty notes were collected at one-tenth in silver; each ingot of silver 50 taels was converted to 25 ingots of notes.

s0468.literal: On yiwei day, the Palace Chancellor Directorate General was commanded not to be subordinate to the Illustrious Merit Chief Commandant's Office.
s0468.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Palace Chancellor Directorate General was commanded not to be subordinate to the Illustrious Merit Chief Commandant's Office.

s0469.literal: On dingyou day, Song Prefecture of Nanyang Prefecture was again granted as Bayan's fief.
s0469.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Song Prefecture of Nanyang Prefecture was again granted as Bayan's fief.

s0470.literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate censors Niegu Bo and Gao Tan memorialized in accusation: "This office's surveillance censor Chen Liang, relying on power and rampant with poison, favoritism and law-breaking — we request removal from office, confiscation of corrupt goods, and return to home district.
s0470.idiomatic: 12th month, on wushen day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate censors Niegu Bo and Gao Tan memorialized in accusation: "This office's surveillance censor Chen Liang, relying on power and rampant with poison, favoritism and law-breaking — we request removal from office, confiscation of corrupt goods, and return to home district.

s0471.literal: " An instruction said: "Though an amnesty has occurred, by the wind-and-banners precedent pursue and seize the patent; the remainder as memorialized."
s0471.idiomatic: " An instruction said: "Though an amnesty has occurred, by the wind-and-banners precedent pursue and seize the patent; the remainder as memorialized."

s0472.literal: A gold tally was inscribed with text reading "Assisting loyalty and pursuing righteousness, upholding integrity and sharing achievement," granted to Western Regions Imperial Guard deputy commander-in-chief Qincha to honor his Hongqiao achievement at the beginning of Tiansli.
s0472.idiomatic: A gold tally was inscribed with text reading "Assisting loyalty and pursuing righteousness, upholding integrity and sharing achievement," granted to Western Regions Imperial Guard deputy commander-in-chief Qincha to honor his Hongqiao achievement at the beginning of Tiansli.

s0473.literal: On renzi day, Prince Hulachu was again ordered to return and guard Yunnan.
s0473.idiomatic: On renzi day, Prince Hulachu was again ordered to return and guard Yunnan.

s0474.literal: On guichou day, Sadun presented sixteen households of Rus'; they were compensated with one hundred seven ingots of silver and five thousand ingots of notes.
s0474.idiomatic: On guichou day, Sadun presented 16 households of Rus'; they were compensated with 107 ingots of silver and 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0475.literal: Pasture lands of Qingchi and Nanpi counties of Hejian Route were granted for Rus' winter quarters, and official sheep pastured by Huli were still supplied to them.
s0475.idiomatic: Pasture lands of Qingchi and Nanpi counties of Hejian Route were granted for Rus' winter quarters, and official sheep pastured by Huli were still supplied to them.

s0476.literal: Henan-Hebei Surveillance associate commissioner Sengianu said: "Since antiquity seeking loyal ministers must be at the gate of filial sons.
s0476.idiomatic: Henan-Hebei Surveillance associate commissioner Sengianu said: "Since antiquity seeking loyal ministers must be at the gate of filial sons.

s0477.literal: Now those serving at court — some ten years without visiting parents — it is not that they lack thought for kin; truly the court has no system for granting leave to visit parents, yet there is prohibition against leaving office on one's own.
s0477.idiomatic: Now those serving at court — some 10 years without visiting parents — it is not that they lack thought for kin; truly the court has no system for granting leave to visit parents, yet there is prohibition against leaving office on one's own.

s0478.literal: Ancient statutes: for officeholders whose parents are within three hundred li, once in three years a fixed provincial leave of twenty days was granted;
s0478.idiomatic: Ancient statutes: for officeholders whose parents are within 300 li, once in 3 years a fixed provincial leave of 20 days was granted;

s0479.literal: for those without parents, once in five years tomb-visiting leave of ten days was granted.
s0479.idiomatic: for those without parents, once in 5 years tomb-visiting leave of 10 days was granted.

s0480.literal: By this reasoning, for parents from three hundred li to ten thousand li, leave periods should be fixed according to distance; those who should visit parents but conceal and do not visit shall be punished.
s0480.idiomatic: By this reasoning, for parents from 300 li to 10,000 li, leave periods should be fixed according to distance; those who should visit parents but conceal and do not visit shall be punished.

s0481.literal: If falsely claiming leave to evade and cover crimes, the same penalty as falsely rushing to mourning."
s0481.idiomatic: If falsely claiming leave to evade and cover crimes, the same penalty as falsely rushing to mourning."

s0482.literal: Censorate officials reported it; the central secretariat, Ministry of Rites, Ministry of Justice, and Hanlin, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and Kuizhang Pavilion were ordered to deliberate.
s0482.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported it; the central secretariat, Ministry of Rites, Ministry of Justice, and Hanlin, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and Kuizhang Pavilion were ordered to deliberate.

s0483.literal: On dingsi day, rain froze on trees.
s0483.idiomatic: On dingsi day, rain froze on trees.

s0484.literal: On wuwu day, Western Regions prince Tultemür dispatched envoys presenting Western horses and grape wine.
s0484.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Western Regions prince Tultemür dispatched envoys presenting Western horses and grape wine.

s0485.literal: Advance grants of yearly allowance notes to the four night guards and various hidden-residence guard soldiers — twenty ingots per man.
s0485.idiomatic: Advance grants of yearly allowance notes to the 4 night guards and various hidden-residence guard soldiers — 20 ingots per man.

s0486.literal: On gengshen day, Academy of Scholarly Worthies direct academician Dasi Man was dispatched to Zhending Yuhua Palace to sacrifice at the spirit halls of Ruizong and the Manifest Virtue and Sagely Empress Dowager.
s0486.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Academy of Scholarly Worthies direct academician Dasi Man was dispatched to Zhending Yuhua Palace to sacrifice at the spirit halls of Ruizong and the Manifest Virtue and Sagely Empress Dowager.

s0487.literal: On xinyou day, Minister of War Yesubuhua and transmission court associate commissioner Hunabuhua were dispatched to welcome the Imperial Preceptor.
s0487.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Minister of War Yesubuhua and transmission court associate commissioner Hunabuhua were dispatched to welcome the Imperial Preceptor.

s0488.literal: An edict ordered central secretariat and censorate to dispatch officials to each circuit together with surveillance offices to record prisoners.
s0488.idiomatic: An edict ordered central secretariat and censorate to dispatch officials to each circuit together with surveillance offices to record prisoners.

s0489.literal: On guihai day, rain froze on trees.
s0489.idiomatic: On guihai day, rain froze on trees.

s0490.literal: Weapons were issued to the Eastern Campaign Martial Prince's headquarters.
s0490.idiomatic: Weapons were issued to the Eastern Campaign Martial Prince's headquarters.

s0491.literal: On dingmao day, censorate officials said: "Gansu Branch Secretariat associate grand councillor Yolu Temür is neither of Mongol ethnicity nor surname, and is dim regarding affairs; to let him hold overall military authority — we fear it is not fitting.
s0491.idiomatic: On dingmao day, censorate officials said: "Gansu Branch Secretariat associate grand councillor Yolu Temür is neither of Mongol ethnicity nor surname, and is dim regarding affairs; to let him hold overall military authority — we fear it is not fitting.

s0492.literal: " An edict commanded the privy council not to let him command and transfer troops.
s0492.idiomatic: " An edict commanded the privy council not to let him command and transfer troops.

s0493.literal: On jisi day, censorate officials said: "Hedong Route surveillance associate commissioner Huqur Buqa; convening Yan-Nan Route surveillance commissioner Buyanqudu, Wang Shiyuan, and Hao Zhishan — the banners of law do not stand firm; they should be removed from office.
s0493.idiomatic: On jisi day, censorate officials said: "Hedong Route surveillance associate commissioner Huqur Buqa; convening Yan-Nan Route surveillance commissioner Buyanqudu, Wang Shiyuan, and Hao Zhishan — the banners of law do not stand firm; they should be removed from office.

s0495.literal: Cui Weixiao of Ninghai Prefecture was honored for filial conduct.
s0495.idiomatic: Cui Weixiao of Ninghai Prefecture was honored for filial conduct.

s0496.literal: This year, prefectures subordinate to Zhending Route suffered flood; Jining and Henan two routes drought; great famine.
s0496.idiomatic: This year, prefectures subordinate to Zhending Route suffered flood; Jining and Henan 2 routes drought; great famine.
